name: c / Sessions by foot, as built (#1910, #1921)

children.text: c/ Sessions by foot: as built

These nine cards are drawn from the app's screenshot suite (test/screenshots/tracks_screenshots_test.dart, "Sessions face"), at 1920×1080, in this file's palette. The pedals sit 29 px lower than on the other foot faces in this file: that is where the app draws them since the screen audit (#1590), and those faces have not been redrawn yet.

The captions. Each track switch is named for its session: the name, then the loop mode and tempo, then "Hold · Open". The second line reads "Open now" for the open session, "Opening…" while an Open is in flight and "Could not open" after one failed, and those switches have no third line.

The readout. One unboxed list above the track switches, seven evenly spaced lines. Its first line's capitals sit on the top of the Clear and Bank pedals' faces, its last line sits on the baseline of their captions, and its left and right edges are the faces of the first and last track switches.

· With no session shown (cards 09, 10, 14): the folder, the page, and "Press a switch to see its session. Hold it to open." While something plays or records, the line above that says what an Open would end.

· With one shown (cards 15, 16, 17): its name, then Loop mode, Tempo, Loop length (left out when none is set), Tracks (eight segments and how many are recorded) and Effects (names in signal order, four and then "+N", or "None"). The last line says what opening it would end, or "Opening…", "Open now", "Could not open".
· Not shown: the saved date, the count-in, the click, each track's layers and waveform, and which place an effect is on.

The Hold. A press shows the session at once, not on release, so a Hold always fills under the name of the session it opens. A release before the threshold opens nothing and leaves the session shown. On the screen the fill is the drawn switch's LED bar, the same bar in the same place as on the pedal. One Hold at a time: a second track switch going down while one is pending cancels both. A Hold opens only if its switch still stands for the same session; when it no longer does (the page turned, the session gone, takes locked) the Hold and its fill end at once.
Where the build differs from the plan:

· The reason an Open failed is in the stage notice, which names the session: "Could not open Encore", with the Library's sentence under it (card 12). The reasons are sentences, too long for a caption.
· The face returns to Tracks, Mute or Custom when it was entered from one of them, and to Tracks from any other mode. Returning into FX would cancel arms and end takes.

· Bank turns the page on contact while there is one folder. With another folder to show it has a Hold, so its page turn waits for the release, as every switch with a Hold does. With one page and another folder it is named "Folder" with "Hold" under it, since its press does nothing (card 14).
· With no open session and no session outside a folder, the face starts on the first folder.
· The drawn pedals take contacts, as on every foot face: touching a track switch shows its session and holding it opens.

LEDs: the switch under the open session, Bank past the first page, and MODE. A held track switch over a session is in the "selected" colour and fills from the left while its Hold is pending. Everything else lights only while held.
Not built: Load previous and Load next session. Still owed on the console: how long an Open takes, and how long the readout's list takes to appear after a press (#1918).
